6362.d: Metsamaastik kahe vees asuva vähipüüdjaga, kel kahvad käes, taga paremal oja kaldal naine koeraga. Taamal mets.
6362.de: Forest landscape with two crayfish catchers standing in the water holding nets, in the background on the right a woman with a dog on the bank of a stream. In the distance a forest.

6394.d: Vaskblondide juustega, näoga vaataja poole pööratud neiu rinnaportree. Keha pööratud paremale, siniste silmade vaade vasakule. Seljas laia valge kraega tumesinine kleit. Foon rohekashall.
6394.de: Bust portrait of a young woman with ash-blonde hair, face turned towards the viewer. Body turned to the right, gaze of the blue eyes to the left. Wearing a dark blue dress with a wide white collar. Background greenish grey.

6417.d: Suvesombune vaade pargiteede lahknemiskohta. Kummalgi pool teed roosaõielised puud rohelistes, nupuliste nurkadega kastides. Tagapool vasakul lilledega ääristatud muruplats, puud-põõsad. Silmapiiril nõlvakul lossi siluett. Paremal rohelised puukroonid. Maal pastelselt hele, läbi sinaka vine nähtud.
6417.de: A summer, overcast view of a fork in park paths. On either side of the path, trees with pink blossoms in green boxes with knobbed corners. Further back on the left, a lawn bordered with flowers, trees and bushes. On the horizon on a slope, the silhouette of a castle. On the right, green tree crowns. The painting pastel-light, seen through a bluish haze.

6485.d: Hallikas, udutaolises üldtoonis, pehmete kontuuridega lumine tänavavaade peaaegu kogu kompositsioonipinda katvate õrnlillade, -kollakate ja -rohekate majafassaadidega tagaplaanil. Keskplaanil vasakus kuldlõikes kuubikujuline kahekorruseline rohekas maja, esiplaanil paremal äärel ühekorruseline lillakas-rohekas puumaja.
6485.de: In a greyish, misty overall tone, a snowy street view with soft contours, with pale purple, pale yellowish and pale greenish house façades covering almost the entire compositional surface in the background. In the middle ground on the left, in the golden section, a cube-shaped two-storey greenish house, in the foreground on the right edge a one-storey purplish-greenish wooden house.

6496.d: Lillakasroosa ehapunas taeva taustal kaks võitlevat ratsanikku: vasakpoolne mustal hobusel raudrüüs, tõstetud mõõk käes. Parempoolne pruunil hobusel viskevalmis odaga eestlasest sõdalane külgvaates. Maalitud jõuliselt, tumedaid kontuurjooni rõhutades.
6496.de: Against the backdrop of a lilac-pink sunset sky, two fighting horsemen: the left one on a black horse in armour, a raised sword in hand. The right one on a brown horse, an Estonian warrior in side view with a spear ready to throw. Painted forcefully, emphasising dark contour lines.

6526.d: Kastanpruunide lokkis juustega tütarlapse pea poolpöördes vasakule. Pruunid mandlilõikelised silmad, teravalt väljajoonistuv korrapärane suu, hea jume. Seljas roheline jakk või kleit, millel oranž krae. Foon peamiselt sinistes ja lillakashallides toonides.
6526.de: The head of a girl with chestnut-brown curly hair in half-turn to the left. Brown almond-shaped eyes, a sharply outlined regular mouth, good complexion. Wearing a green jacket or dress with an orange collar. Background mainly in blue and purplish-grey tones.

6527.d: Esiplaanil paremal männid. Neist vasakul põõsas ning vasakult alumisest nurgast paremale kulgev metsavahetee. Teest vasakul, foonil segamets. Puude vahelt paistab hallikassinine taevas. Valdavad on mitmesugused rohelised toonid, maalitud põõsaste ja puude võra osas pastoosselt.
6527.de: In the foreground on the right, pine trees. To their left a bush and a forest track running from the lower left corner to the right. To the left of the track, in the background, mixed forest. Between the trees, a greyish-blue sky is visible. Various shades of green predominate, the foliage of the bushes and trees painted pastosely.

6540.d: Esiplaanil paadi nina punase purjega. Vasakul ehmunud näoga mehe poolfiguur. Paremal stiliseeritud laine valges vahus näha naise figuur pikkade blondide juustega.
6540.de: In the foreground the bow of a boat with a red sail. On the left the half-figure of a man with a startled face. On the right in the white foam of a stylised wave the figure of a woman with long blonde hair is visible.

6692.d: Esiplaanil lopsakas rohi, paremal mitmetes värvides puid-põõsaid. Vasakul madal talumaja, mille tagant paistab kaevukook. Pintslitõmme lai, laineline.
6692.de: In the foreground lush grass, on the right trees and bushes in various colours. On the left a low farmhouse, behind which a well-sweep is visible. The brushstroke is broad, wavy.

6708.d: Paremal eest taha suunduv veekogu, mille vasakul kaldal hoone puudega, paremal kivimüür, selle taga puid.
6708.de: On the right a body of water running from front to back, on the left bank of which a building with trees, on the right a stone wall, behind it trees.

6767.d: Esiplaanil aia taga maja nurk (vasakul), keskel tee, taamal puud.
6767.de: In the foreground behind a fence the corner of a house (on the left), in the middle a path, trees in the distance.

6768.d: Esiplaanil tara ääres kaks kurniviskavat ja kaks puhkavat poissi. Vasakult taha suunduv latt-tara.
6768.de: In the foreground, by a fence, two boys turning somersaults and two boys resting. A lath fence running back from the left.

6769.d: Murul vasemal selgvaates Kalevipoeg - valges vöötatud särgis - ja Sorts paremal vägikaigast vedamas.
6769.de: On the grass on the left, in clear view, Kalevipoeg - in a white striped shirt - and Sorts on the right, pulling a tug-of-war pole.

6864.d: Lumivalgete juuste ning täishabeme ja vurrudega vana mehe pea, otsevaates. Juuksed kammitud vasakule lahku. Alumised silmalaud tugevalt kottis. Foon sinine.
6864.de: Head of an old man with snow-white hair and a full beard and moustache, frontal view. Hair combed parted to the left. Lower eyelids heavily baggy. Background blue.

6866.d: Vee piiril taeva taustal astuv Kalevipoeg selgvaates, lauakoorem vasakul õlal, kirjatud tupes mõõk vööl. Paremal jändriku männi latv, silmapiiril metsaviirg. Maal dekoratiivselt värvikas, figuuri ümbritseb pruun kontuurjoon.
6866.de: At the water's edge against the sky Kalevipoeg striding, seen frontally, a load of boards on his left shoulder, an ornamented sword in its sheath at his belt. On the right the crown of a gnarled pine, a strip of forest on the horizon. The painting decoratively colourful, the figure surrounded by a brown contour line.

6867.d: Metsaveerel istuv Kalevipoeg külgvaates vasakule, ristatud käed põlvedel. Paremal, tema selja taga lähenemas hulk sõjamehi kilpide ja mõõkadega. Taamal maastik veekoguga, rünkpilvine taevas. Maal erksavärviline, kujundid ümbritsetud peene tumeda kontuurjoonega.
6867.de: Kalevipoeg sitting at the edge of a forest, in side view facing left, arms crossed on his knees. On the right, behind him, a host of warriors with shields and swords approaching. In the distance a landscape with a body of water, a sky with cumulus clouds. The painting is brightly coloured, the figures outlined with a fine dark contour line.

6868.d: Vasakul seisev Kalevipoeg otsevaates, jalad harkis, langetatud mõõk paremas käes. Tema taga vana kandlemängija, juuksed tuules ja rida seisvaid sõdalasi, piigid püsti. Taamal muistne linnus.
6868.de: Kalevipoeg standing on the left in a frontal view, legs apart, lowered sword in his right hand. Behind him an old kannel player, hair in the wind, and a row of standing warriors, spears upright. In the distance an ancient stronghold.

6869.d: Rannal istuva muistse eestlase /Kalevipoeg/ 3/4 figuur külgvaates vasakule. Mees kätest-jalust köidetud jämeda ketiga kalju külge. Pea rinnal, käed toetuvad taha, jalad ette sirutatud. Taga vasakul tema kohale kummarduva alasti naise poolfiguur veerandpöördes paremale. Taustaks kivine mererand.
6869.de: 3/4 figure of an ancient Estonian sitting on the shore /Kalevipoeg/, in side view facing left. The man bound hand and foot with a thick chain to a cliff. Head on chest, arms resting behind, legs stretched forward. Behind on the left, the half-figure of a naked woman bending over him, in a three-quarter turn to the right. Background a rocky sea coast.

6870.d: Kolm otsesuunas sõitvat täispurjedes viikingite laeva tähistaeva foonil. Laevadel seisvad sõdalased. Purjedel ornament. Maal sinakas koloriidis, kujundid tugeva kontuurjoonega piiritletud.
6870.de: Three fully-sailed Viking ships sailing straight ahead against a starry sky background. Warriors standing on the ships. Ornament on the sails. The painting in bluish tones, the shapes delineated with a strong contour line.

6871.d: Lagendikul grupp mände, tüvedel päikeselaigud. Puude varjud maapinnal. Tüvede taga helesinine taevas, kaugem metsaviirg. Maalil erksad sinised-rohelised toonid.
6871.de: A group of pines in a clearing, sunspots on the trunks. Shadows of the trees on the ground. Behind the trunks, a light blue sky, a distant strip of forest. The painting is in bright blue-green tones.

6872.d: Sopiliste kallastega veekogu ääres esiplaanil vasakul kolm, paremal kaks pikavarrelist punase kobaraõisikuga taime. Silmapiiril kahvatu kuu, peegeldus vees. Maal sinakais toonides täppivalt, paralleelsete pintslilöökidega maalitud.
6872.de: By the shore of a body of water with indented banks, in the foreground on the left three, on the right two long-stemmed plants with red clustered inflorescences. On the horizon, a pale moon, reflected in the water. The painting is executed in bluish tones, dabbed with parallel brushstrokes.

7028.d: Üks püsti ja teine kummargil naine mere ääres jalgupidi vees pesu loputamas. Lillas, oranžis ja rohekas toonis.
7028.de: One woman standing and another bent over, rinsing laundry by the sea with their feet in the water. In purple, orange and greenish tones.

7047.d: Üle pildipinna grupp sügisesi kolletavaid kaski, ülaservaga ladvad ära lõigatud. Maapind ees kolletav, läbi puude paistab sinetav taevas.
7047.de: Across the picture plane a group of autumnal yellowing birches, their crowns cut off at the upper edge. The ground in front is yellowing, and a bluish sky is visible through the trees.

7049.d: Valge, pika täishabemega ning vuntsidega vana mehe portree. Pea kummardatud ette alla, silmalaud kuldraamidega prillide taga langetatud. Valgus langeb vasakult.
7049.de: Portrait of an old man with a white, long full beard and moustache. His head is bowed forward and down, his eyelids lowered behind gold-framed spectacles. The light falls from the left.

7050.d: Ookerkollasel foonil punases pluusis ja kübaras keskealise naise põlvportree veerandpöördes vasakule. Vasaku käega hoiab süles rohelist rätti, parem käsi põlvel. Maalitud ühtlaste, laiemate pinstlilöökidega.
7050.de: Knee-length portrait of a middle-aged woman in a red blouse and hat against an ochre-yellow background, in a quarter-turn to the left. With her left hand she holds a green scarf on her lap, her right hand rests on her knee. Painted with even, broader brush strokes.

7051.dm: kõrgus: 31.4 cm (km); laius: 35.0 cm (lm); kõrgus: 40.0 cm (lm); laius: 23.0 cm (km)
7051.d: Hallipäise, keskelt lahku kammitud juustega vana naise portree. Pea kummardatud ette alla; laud langetatud. Näo veidi kandiline joon rõhutatud valge kraega. Koloriit tume.
7051.de: Portrait of an old woman with grey hair parted in the middle. Head bowed forward and down; gaze lowered. The slightly angular line of the face is emphasized by a white collar. Dark colouring.

7052.d: Samblarohelistes toonides täppivalt maalitud kaldapealne, vasakul käharad puudepuhmad, paremal pruunikas nõlvak. Esiplaanil vesi peegelduva kaldarohelusega.
7052.de: A moss-green-toned, dabbed painting of a waterside, on the left curly clumps of trees, on the right a brownish slope. In the foreground water with reflecting green of the bank.

7140.d: Esiplaanil olevate puutüvede vahelt paistab punase kivikatusega, valgete seintega kabel roheliste lehtpuude taustal.
7140.de: Through the tree trunks in the foreground a chapel with a red tiled roof and white walls is visible against a background of green deciduous trees.

7141.d: Ees rohuribal keskel ringis tantsivate naiste figuurid. Neist vasemal kännul istuv mees kannelt mängimas, tema ees poolalasti mees nooleotsaga. Seljataga kolm poolalasti meest vibudega. Tantsijaist paremal kaks odadega, kolm vibuga meest ja rahvarõivas neiu. Tema kõrval meesfiguur, käsi ümber neiu piha.
7141.de: In front, on a strip of grass, figures of women dancing in a circle in the middle. To their left, a man sitting on a stump playing a kannel, in front of him a half-naked man with an arrowhead. Behind him three half-naked men with bows. To the right of the dancers, two men with spears, three with bows, and a maiden in folk costume. Beside her, a male figure with an arm around the maiden's waist.

7143.d: Vasakul koerteajaja nelja koeraga. Keskel ratsanik pasunat puhumas. Paremal kolm jahimeest lastud põdraga. Nende taga järv marjakobarais pihlakas ja kasetüved. Taamal vasakul kirik, keskel lossivaremed.
7143.de: On the left a dog handler with four dogs. In the centre a horseman blowing a horn. On the right three hunters with a shot elk. Behind them a lake, a rowan tree with clusters of berries and birch trunks. In the distance on the left a church, in the middle castle ruins.

7144.d: Mehe poolfiguur istuvas asendis, pöördes vasakule. Helehall juus, kollakad vurrud. Käed põlvedel, vasakus käes sinine raamat. Tume ülikond, valge püstkraega, roheline lips.
7144.de: Half-figure of a man in a seated position, turned to the left. Light grey hair, yellowish moustache. Hands on his knees, a blue book in his left hand. Dark suit, white stand-up collar, green tie.

7145.d: Istuva vanema naise poolfiguur profiilis vasakule. Parem käsi toetatud lauale. Pruunid juuksed, sinine valge kirjaga pluus, tume seelik, õlgadel roheline rätik. Tugevasti toonitatud kontuur. Parema õla taga sinine pind, foon rohekas.
7145.de: Half-figure of a seated older woman in profile to the left. Right hand resting on a table. Brown hair, blue blouse with white lettering, dark skirt, green shawl on the shoulders. Strongly toned contour. Blue surface behind the right shoulder, background greenish.

7146.d: Heledas, pehmes viltkübaras mehe rinnaportree, kerges pöördes paremale. Nägu kujult piklik, silmad lähestikku asetsevad, kergelt pungis; ninajoon peen; suu väike. Seljas hall kuub ja sviiter. Taust hele.
7146.de: Bust portrait of a man in a light, soft felt hat, in a slight turn to the right. Face elongated in shape, eyes set close together, slightly bulging; nose line thin; mouth small. Wearing a grey coat and a sweater. Background light.

7147.d: Pildi allosas kaks madalat taluhoonet nende ümber kasvavate puude-põõsastega. 2/3 maalipinnast võtab enda alla sinine, valgete pilvekaharatega taevas.
7147.de: In the lower part of the picture two low farm buildings with trees and bushes growing around them. 2/3 of the painting's surface is taken up by a blue sky with fluffy white clouds.

7149.d: Jämedate puutüvede vahel kolm alasti mehefiguuri. Keskmisel, esiplaanil oleval mehel käes õlakõrgusele tõstetud kepp. Tema juures, paremal valgepruuni laiguline koer. Figuurid tahtlikult teostatud disproportsionaalsetena; kontuurid kergelt rõhutatud. Maastiku juures kasutatud stiliseerivat laadi. Värvikiht õhuke.
7149.de: Three nude male figures among thick tree trunks. The middle man, in the foreground, holds a stick raised to shoulder height. Next to him, on the right, a white-brown spotted dog. The figures are deliberately rendered disproportionate; contours slightly emphasised. A stylising manner is used for the landscape. Thin paint layer.

7198.d: 1/3 tööst lageda välja all. Silmapiiril metsad. 2/3 pilvine taevas.
7198.de: 1/3 of the work is open field below. Forests on the horizon. 2/3 cloudy sky.

7199.d: Esiplaanil heinamaa keskel tiik, selle taga vasakul puudesalu, paremal lahesopp purjekatega, silmapiiril rannaviirg. Osaliselt pilvine taevas.
7199.de: In the foreground a pond in the middle of a meadow, behind it on the left a grove, on the right a bay inlet with sailboats, on the horizon a coastline. Partly cloudy sky.

7247.d: Natüürmort torukübara, jalutuskepi, kinnaste ja valge salliga.
7247.de: Still life with a top hat, a walking stick, gloves and a white scarf.

7274.d: Suured lillad kivid rohekas-sinise taeva taustal.
7274.de: Large purple stones against a greenish-blue sky background.

7304.d: Ees paekivipõrand, paremal akna all nurgas puukapp. Ülal rida portreid. Keskel trepp balustraadiga vasakul. Vasakul seljaga vastu trepi käsipuud kapp, selle juures tool ja pikas kleidis naise figuur.
7304.de: In front, a limestone floor, on the right under the window in the corner a wooden cabinet. Above, a row of portraits. In the middle a staircase with a balustrade on the left. On the left, with its back to the staircase handrail, a cabinet, next to it a chair and the figure of a woman in a long dress.

7372.d: Esiplaanil peaaegu peegelsile merepind. Horisondil rannaäär. 3/4 tööst rünkpilvedega taeva all.
7372.de: In the foreground an almost mirror-smooth sea surface. Coastline on the horizon. 3/4 of the work under a sky with cumulus clouds.

7379.d: Esiplaanil looklev lumine tee. Taga lumine mets.
7379.de: In the foreground a winding snowy road. Behind it a snowy forest.

7381.d: Ees keskel ja paremal veekogu. Vasakul madal kivine kallas. Vastaskaldal järsuseinalised kaljud.
7381.de: In front, in the middle and on the right, a body of water. On the left a low stony shore. On the opposite shore steep-walled cliffs.

7435.d: Vaade Tallinna Toomkiriku kooriruumi vappidega seinale.
7435.de: View of the wall with coats of arms in the choir of Tallinn Cathedral.

7482.d: Esiplaanil rohtunud kallastega veekogu. Tagapool vasakul madal, rohtunud lehtpuutukkadega kallas.
7482.de: In the foreground a body of water with overgrown banks. Further back on the left a low bank overgrown with clumps of deciduous trees.

7813.d: Esiplaanil üksikud kased ristlevate teeradade ääres. Eemal vasemal üksik hoone, pearemal mets lattaiaga. Kauguses ebamäärane figuur.
7813.de: In the foreground isolated birches beside crossing paths. In the distance on the left a single building, on the right a forest with a plank fence. A vague figure in the distance.

7814.d: Vasakul jõekaldal asetsev väike palkehitis, mille kohal kalda veerel seisev mehefiguur punases särgis, õngeritv käes. Käänuna paremale suunduva jõe vasakul kaldal rida madalaid taluhooneid puusalu ja pilvedega taeva taustal.
7814.de: On the left riverbank a small log building, above which, standing at the water's edge, a male figure in a red shirt, a fishing rod in hand. On the left bank of the river, which curves to the right, a row of low farm buildings against a background of a birch grove and clouded sky.

7817.d: Ees madalate mättaliste kallaste vahel taha paremale suunduv jõgi kalamehega parempoolsel kaldal. Taga paremal okaspuumetsaga kaetud järsunõlvaline mägi, vasakul puisniit.
7817.de: In front, between low tussocky banks, a river running back to the right, with a fisherman on the right-hand bank. Behind at right a steep-sloped mountain covered with coniferous forest, at left a wooded meadow.

7818.d: Esiplaanil jõgi paadiga ja üksikud puutüved, taamal mets onniga. Metsa vahelt, pildi keskel, langeb loojunud päikese punakat valgust.
7818.de: In the foreground a river with a boat and single tree trunks, in the distance a forest with a hut. Through the trees, in the centre of the picture, falls the reddish light of the setting sun.

7824.d: Esiplaanil keskel veekogu (jõgi), mida vasakult ja paremalt piiravad kaldad. Vasakul kaldal üksikud madalad pajud, paremal õlgkatusega maja ja lehtpuude salu. Veel lootsik üksiku inimkoguga. Taustaks ehapunas taevas.
7824.de: In the foreground, in the middle, a body of water (a river) bordered on the left and right by banks. On the left bank isolated low willows, on the right a straw-roofed house and a grove of deciduous trees. Also a boat with a lone group of people. Background of a sky glowing red at sunset.

7838.d: Esiplaanil künkal suur, lumega kaetud puu. Taamal mets. Üle maastiku kaardub hämar taevas. Paremal pool taevas lind lendamas.
7838.de: In the foreground on a hillock a large, snow-covered tree. In the background a forest. A dim sky arches over the landscape. On the right side of the sky a bird flying.

7840.d: Vasakul pildi sügavusesse suunduv jõgi. Selle paremal kaldal tee, mida mööda sõidab hobune vankriga. Tagapool majad ja õitsvad puud.
7840.de: On the left a river receding into the depth of the picture. On its right bank a road along which a horse is drawing a cart. Behind, houses and blossoming trees.

7841.d: Keskel valge, verandade ja rõdudega maja, mida kroonib kuuetahuline torn. Maja taga on aimata tumedates toonides antud pargipuid ja-põõsaid. Esiplaanil liivatatud teed, puupink, viimasest paremal muruplats lillepeenraga. Vasakult langev päikesevalgus valgustab torni ja katuseviilu.
7841.de: In the centre, a white house with verandas and balconies, crowned by a hexagonal tower. Behind the house, park trees and bushes are suggested in dark tones. In the foreground, sanded paths, a wooden bench, and to the right of the latter a lawn with a flower bed. Sunlight falling from the left illuminates the tower and the gable roof.

7844.d: Laual kaks roosakat roosi, taga kuldrandiga tass.
7844.de: Two pinkish roses on the table, behind them a cup with a gilded rim.

7868.dm: kõrgus: 36.2 cm (km); laius: 31.2 cm (lm   ); laius: 29.3 cm (km   ); kõrgus: 39.2 cm (lm   )
7868.d: Kolmnurgale ülesehitatud kahefiguuriline kompositsioonigrupp, esiplaanil naise kuju. Pead pöörates üleõla paremale. Sinisel foonil kaheksa tähte.
7868.de: A two-figure composition group built on a triangle, in the foreground the figure of a woman. Turning her head over her shoulder to the right. Eight stars on a blue background.

7869.d: Tiik, paremal laugjalt tõusva kõrge kaldapealsega. Taamal puude allee. Koloriit hele, valdav roheline toon.
7869.de: A pond, on the right a high bank rising gently. An avenue of trees in the distance. Colouring light, predominant tone green.

7870.dm: kõrgus: 36.3 cm (lm); laius: 36.3 cm (lm   ); laius: 25.9 cm (lm  ); kõrgus: 25.9 cm (lm)

7910.dm: lehe kõrgus: 30.0 cm; lehe laius: 23.3 cm
7910.d: Ees kätega seljataga olevale aiale toetuv naise alasti täisfiguur en face. Pea kallutatud vasemale õlale. Taga kaskedega ääreistatud rohumaa.
7910.de: In the foreground a full-length nude female figure, en face, leaning with her hands on a fence behind her. Head tilted towards the left shoulder. Behind, a meadow bordered with birches.

8024.d: Tumeroheline nõlvak, siluetselt lahendatud puudega heleda taeva foonil. Esiplaanil paremal kolm, vasakul üks rohtu sööv lammas.
8024.de: A dark green slope with trees rendered in silhouette against a light sky. In the foreground, three sheep grazing on the right and one on the left.

8033.d: Kaks tiigrit profiilis vasakule metsa taustal.
8033.de: Two tigers in profile facing left against a forest background.

8041.d: Esiplaanil paremal kolm alastifiguuri, keskmine selgvaates kiviheiteasendis. Keskplaanil veekogu, millel luigeparv. Tagaplaanil mets.
8041.de: In the foreground on the right three nude figures, the middle one seen frontally in the pose of throwing a stone. In the middle ground a body of water with a flock of swans. In the background forest.

8081.dm: lehe kõrgus: 31.2 cm; laius: 51.4 cm (tervik, lm.   )
8081.d: Lagedal, lumisel väljakul kahes reas, eest taha suunduvad ostjate-müüjate read.
8081.de: On an open, snowy square in two rows, rows of buyers and sellers extending from front to back.

8089.d: Varakevadine maastik. Siin-seal lumelaike. Järve kaldal, vasakul pildiserval, väike maja ja lumine heinasaad. Tagaplaanil metsatukk.
8089.de: Early spring landscape. Patches of snow here and there. On the shore of a lake, on the left edge of the picture, a small house and a snowy haystack. A clump of forest in the background.

8109.d: Esiplaanil pruunides toonides maapind, mis keskel läheb järsult üle roheliseks. Vasakule jääb heinaküün. Ülal diagonaalselt taevariba. Värv kantud lõuendile laiade pintslilüketega, horisontaalselt.
8109.de: In the foreground ground in brown tones, which in the middle changes abruptly to green. On the left is a hay barn. Above, a diagonal strip of sky. The paint is applied to the canvas in broad, horizontal brushstrokes.

8122.d: Vaade talvisele turuplatsile. Esiplaanil keskel heinu sööv must hobune heinaveovankriga. Tagapool hulk hobuseid vankritega, inimeste grupid nende ümber. Taamal keskel kahekorruseline hoone, paremal torniga ja väiksemad majad. Taevas ja maa sulavad ühtlaseks helehall-valkjaks pinnaks, lumel üksikuid sinakad ja pruunid varjud. Maalitud siledalt, maapind veidi pastoossemalt.
8122.de: View of a winter market square. In the foreground centre a black horse eating hay, with a hay cart. Further back a number of horses with carts, groups of people around them. In the distance in the centre a two-storey building, on the right one with a tower and smaller houses. The sky and ground merge into a uniform light grey-whitish surface, with occasional bluish and brown shadows on the snow. Painted smoothly, the ground somewhat more pastose.

8126.d: Laugjas, lumine mäenõlv, kolme, sinakaid varje heitva puuga. Tagaplaanil paremal üksik inimfiguur.
8126.de: A gently sloping, snowy mountainside, with three trees casting bluish shadows. In the background on the right a solitary human figure.

8127.d: Niidetud viljapõld, keskel kaks rida rõuke. Silmapiiril sinerdab metsaviirg.
8127.de: A mown grain field, in the middle two rows of stooks. On the horizon, a strip of forest shows blue.

8128.d: Suvises, päikesepaistelises maastikus heledas rõivastuses noormees kurni mängimas. Keha hoovõtul ettekummardunud, käed kepiga heitevalmilt õlajoonele tõstetud. Tagaplaanil paistab puudevahelt veekogu. Koloriit hele.
8128.de: In a summer, sunlit landscape a young man in light-coloured clothing playing kurni (a throwing game). Body bent forward on the run-up, arms raised to shoulder level with a stick ready to throw. In the background a body of water is visible through the trees. Bright colouring.

8189.de: Pines against a light sky background.

8218.d: Noore naise põlvportree otsevaates, rohelise lehestiku taustal. Peas hele müts, seljas pluus ja triibuline seelik. Käes hoiab rukkililli.
8218.de: Frontal knee-length portrait of a young woman, against a background of green foliage. On her head a light-coloured hat, wearing a blouse and striped skirt. She holds cornflowers in her hand.

8219.d: Ämbrite ja kaelkookudega naise kolmveerandfiguur pöördes vasakule. Naise seljataga roigasaed. Tagaplaanil põõsaste ja puudega maastik, mis varjab taeva ja silmapiiri.
8219.de: Three-quarter figure of a woman with buckets and a yoke, turned to the left. Behind the woman a pole fence. In the background a landscape with bushes and trees hiding the sky and horizon.

8271.d: Paremalt vasakule läheb diagonaalselt kitsas tee, tehes vasakus servas kaare ning kadudes keskplaanis kasvava suure puu juures pildi sügavusse. Esiplaanil, tee veerel, maapinnale sinakaid varje heitev puu; paremal tee ääres, madal valge pink. Intensiivsed rohelised toonid, teelint roosa.
8271.de: A narrow path runs diagonally from right to left, curving at the left edge and disappearing into the depth of the picture near a large tree growing in the middle ground. In the foreground, at the edge of the path, a tree casting bluish shadows on the ground; on the right by the path, a low white bench. Intense green tones, the path a pink ribbon.

8289.d: Esiplaanil istuva naise poolfiguur, sülle asetatud kätega. Tumedad, keskelt lahku kammitud lainelised juuksed. Roosal põhjal sini-punaste lilledega kleit pitskraega. Taustaks toa interjöör.
8289.de: Half-figure of a seated woman in the foreground, with hands placed in her lap. Dark, wavy hair parted in the middle. Dress with blue-red flowers on a pink background, with a lace collar. Background a room interior.

8297.d: Kollakaspruunil lauatahvlil, mis katab maali alumise kolmandiku, asetsevad lillkapsas, selle ees paremal kolm kurki. Nende taga kaks suurt sibulat. Esiplaanil vasakus kuldlõikes kaks redist. Pildi vasakul poolel tühi laiakaelaline pudel, selle ees suur supilusikas ja poolik sidrun.
8297.de: On a yellowish-brown table board covering the lower third of the painting lie a cauliflower, in front of it to the right three cucumbers. Behind them two large onions. In the foreground, in the golden section to the left, two radishes. On the left side of the picture an empty wide-necked bottle, in front of it a large soup spoon and half a lemon.

8364.d: Esiplaanil rohetavate samblalaikudega kaetud suuremad ja väiksemad kivid. Nende vahel kasvamas paar puud. Tagaplaanil kollendav viljapõld.
8364.de: In the foreground larger and smaller stones covered with greenish moss patches. A couple of trees growing among them. In the background a yellowing grain field.

8365.d: Kogu pildipinna võtab enda alla sihvaka tüvega männi haraliste okstega latv. Taust diagonaalselt kaheks pinnaks, mets roheliseks ning taevas siniseks jagatud.
8365.de: The entire picture surface is occupied by the treetop with spreading branches of a slender-trunked pine. The background is divided diagonally into two areas, the forest green and the sky blue.

8367.d: Rohelisel foonil, seljaga vaataja poole vasakul küljel lamav naisakt. Figuur joonistatud sinise pastelliga.
8367.de: On a green background, a female nude lying on her left side, back to the viewer. The figure is drawn with blue pastel.

8368.d: Vanema naise 3/4 figuur, pöördes paremale. Pea kergelt ette kallutatud, käed vaheliti rinnal. Tumedaid juukseid katab pottmüts, ümber õlgade sügavsinine rätt. Taust ooker.
8368.de: 3/4 figure of an older woman, turned to the right. Head slightly bowed forward, hands crossed on the chest. Dark hair covered by a pot-shaped cap, a deep blue shawl around the shoulders. Background ochre.

8369.d: Valges särgis mehefiguur, paremas käes paljastatud mõõk. Vasak käsi pistetud vöövahele. Taustaks mets.
8369.de: Figure of a man in a white shirt, a bared sword in his right hand. Left hand tucked into his belt. Background of forest.

8370.d: Vaade Rataskaevu tänavale. Paremale jäävad Mihkli ja Niguliste kiriku hooned; vasakul punasekatuselised elumajad. Värvigamma hele, hallika üldtooniga.
8370.de: View of Rataskaevu Street. On the right are the buildings of St Michael's and St Nicholas' churches; on the left residential houses with red roofs. Colour range light, with a greyish overall tone.

8394.d: Esiplaanil kõrrepõld. Paremal ja vasakul reas rukkihakid. Nendest tagapool näha üksikud kuused. Taevas roosakad pilved.
8394.de: In the foreground, a stubble field. On the right and left, rows of rye stooks. Beyond them, single spruce trees are visible. Pinkish clouds in the sky.

8405.d: Madalale maalitud silmapiiriga panoraamne merevaade. Esiplaanil keskel läbi vee paistavaid kive ja laeva küljest tormis murdunud küljeosa. Taamal vasakul veel üks laeva osadest, silmapiiril paremal väike aurik. Meri terashall, madalate vahuste lainetega. Silmapiiri kohal valkjate, esiplaanil hallide pilvedaga selginev taevas.
8405.de: A panoramic sea view with a low-painted horizon. In the foreground in the centre, stones visible through the water and a side section broken off from a ship's hull in a storm. Further back on the left another section of the ship, on the horizon on the right a small steamer. The sea steel-grey, with low foamy waves. Above the horizon a clearing sky, whitish, grey in the foreground with clouds.

8490.d: Nooremapoolse mehe profiilportree; tahapoole kammitud satäänid juuksed, mille piir laubal kaarjalt taandunud, sirge nina, lõual juustega ühte värvi habemetutt. Seljas tume kuub, kaelas roheline rätik või lips. Foon kahe tooni piiriga diagonaalselt läbi lõigatud: ülalt sinakashall, altpoolt rohekasinine.
8490.de: A profile portrait of a younger man; satiny hair combed back, its line receding in an arch at the forehead, a straight nose, a tuft of beard on the chin matching the hair colour. Wearing a dark coat, with a green scarf or tie at the neck. The background is cut diagonally by a border between two tones: bluish-grey above, greenish-blue below.

8496.d: Esiplaanil paremal bordoopunase sametiga kaetud laud, millel veiniklaas, valge taldrik viinamarjadega, kristallist kann. Esiplaanil vasakul, laua taga, seljaga vaataja poole, kitarri mängiv mees tumedast puust käetugedega toolis. Mehel lühikesed juuksed, tumedad lopsakad kulmud ja vuntsid, seljas tumesinine ülikond ja valge särk. Mehe vastas teisel pool lauda õhtukleidis ja karusnahas daam, pea viltu, pilk malbelt maha suunatud, aluale toetuvad vasakus käes viinamari. Daamist paremal, seinal, ovaalses nikerdatud raamis peegel või maal. Mehest vasakul kõrge tumeroheline toataim. Foon tumehall.
8496.de: In the foreground on the right a table covered with burgundy-red velvet, on which stands a wine glass, a white plate with grapes, a crystal jug. In the foreground on the left, behind the table, with his back to the viewer, a man playing guitar in a dark wood armchair. The man has short hair, dark bushy eyebrows and a moustache, wearing a dark blue suit and a white shirt. Opposite the man, on the other side of the table, a lady in an evening gown and fur, her head tilted, gaze gently lowered, holding a grape in her left hand resting on the table. To the right of the lady, on the wall, a mirror or painting in an oval carved frame. To the left of the man a tall dark green houseplant. The background dark grey.

8499.d: Rohelisel mustrilisel vaibal lamav pruunikarvaline koer. Pea lebab väljasirutatud vasakul käpal. Koloriit tume; maalipind kergelt faktuurne.
8499.de: A brown-furred dog lying on a green patterned rug. The head rests on an outstretched left paw. The colouring is dark; the painting surface is slightly textured.

8608.d: Esiplaanil veekogu. Kaldal rohelise-kollasekirjud puud-põõsad. Üle nende paistab heleda hoone siluett. Taevas pilvitu. Värvigamma hele. Maalimislaad impressionistlik.
8608.de: In the foreground a body of water. On the bank green-yellow mottled trees and bushes. Above them the silhouette of a bright building is visible. The sky is cloudless. Bright colour range. Impressionist painting style.

8609.dm: kõrgus: 28.7 cm (km   ); laius: 29.8 cm (lm  ); laius: 28.5 cm (km); kõrgus: 30.9 cm (lm)
8609.d: Esiplaanil paremal, veekogu kaldal lamava figuuri siluett. Tagaplaanil, vastaskladal paistavad mäed. Valdav sinine värvigamma.
8609.de: In the foreground right, the silhouette of a figure lying on the shore of a body of water. In the background, on the opposite shore, mountains are visible. Predominant blue colour range.

8610.d: Noore naise rinnaportree, profiilis vasakule. Näo osa väljamaalitud. Juuksed, rohekas kõrge kaelusega kleit ning bordoopunane foon lõpetamata.
8610.de: Bust portrait of a young woman, in profile to the left. Part of the face is painted in. Hair, greenish high-collared dress and burgundy-red background unfinished.

8611.d: Seljaga vaataja poole seisab kaarja avause ees heledapäine mees. Üle vasaku õla loomanahk, paremas käes paljastatud mõõk. Avausest paistab kosk ning punetav taevas.
8611.de: A fair-haired man stands with his back to the viewer before an arched opening. An animal hide over his left shoulder, a bared sword in his right hand. Through the opening a waterfall and a reddening sky are visible.

8612.d: Ookril alusel, lillakas-roosal foonil uhmer koos uhmrinuiaga.
8612.de: On an ochre stand, against a purplish-pink background, a mortar with a pestle.

8635.d: a) Esiplaanil keskel kõrge jalaga sinine klaaspokaal suurte valgete õitega. Kollane foon.
8635.de: a) In the foreground in the middle a tall-stemmed blue glass goblet with large white flowers. Yellow background.

8745.d: Esiplaanil heledad sinakasbeežid lamedad luited, tagapool madalad männid, põõsad. Vasakul kaks kõrgemat, jändriku tüvega mändi, puukroonid õrnlillaka taeva taustal. Maalitud õhukese värvikihiga, paber kumab läbi.
8745.de: In the foreground, light bluish-beige flat dunes, behind them low pines and bushes. On the left two taller, gnarled-trunked pines, tree crowns against a background of pale lilac sky. Painted with a thin layer of paint, the paper shows through.

8750.d: Esiplaanil taluõuel põrsad. Keskel vana õlgkatusega talumaja. Paremal kivimüür. Vasakul madala aia taga puid.
8750.de: In the foreground of a farmyard, piglets. In the middle, an old thatched-roof farmhouse. On the right, a stone wall. On the left, trees behind a low fence.

8758.d: Mägine Krimmi maastik: paremal esiplaanil mustriline kivist tänavarinnatis ja paljastunud kivirahnud, mille peal ja vahel kasvavad puud. Rinnatisele nõjatudes avaneb vasakul panoraamne vaade metsaga kaetud madalatele mägedele, mis kauguses on antud sinaka mäemassiivina. Mägede kohal valged pilvekuhilad, ülal helesinine taevas.(eesti)
8758.de: Mountainous Crimean landscape: in the right foreground a patterned stone street parapet and exposed boulders, on and among which trees grow. Leaning on the parapet, a panoramic view opens on the left of forested low mountains, given in the distance as a bluish mountain massif. Above the mountains white cloud banks, above a light blue sky.

8791.d: Õunapuu all naise poolfiguur, käes korv õuntega. Eredalt oranzil foonil lillakad ihutoonid, pluus rohekas, lehestik tume lillakate toonide domineerides.
8791.de: Under an apple tree the half-figure of a woman, holding a basket with apples. Against a bright orange background, purplish skin tones, the blouse greenish, the foliage dark with purplish tones dominating.

8825.d: Laual vasakul punutud korvis joogikarhvin, selle kõrval pokaal tumepunase veiniga. Nende ees paremal poolenisti kooritud sidrunile toetuv taldrik, millel erkpunane vähk. Taldriku serva alt paistab noa pea, paremal sidrun. Maal pruunikashallis koloriidis, üksikud heledad valguslaigud taldrikul, karhvinil, klaasil.
8825.de: On the table, on the left, a drink carafe in a woven basket, next to it a goblet with dark red wine. In front of them, on the right, a plate resting on a half-peeled lemon, on which a bright red crayfish. The head of a knife is visible under the edge of the plate, a lemon on the right. The painting in brownish-grey colouring, individual light patches of light on the plate, the carafe, the glass.

8844.d: Kolm embuses paari, äärmised seljaga vaataja poole. Maalitud pehmete, lainjate joontega, rõhutades figuuride paindes siluette. Valdavalt sinised toonid.
8844.de: Three embracing couples, the outer ones with their backs to the viewer. Painted with soft, wavy lines, emphasising the curved silhouettes of the figures. Predominantly blue tones.

8845.dm: kõrgus: 27.2 cm (km); laius: 54.2 cm (lm); laius: 52.0 cm (km ); kõrgus: 29.2 cm (lm)
8845.d: Töö jaotatud kolmeks osaks. Vasakul: lõke, selle ümber istuva kolme figuuriga. Keskel väravast kinnihoidev heledajuukseline mees. Seljas ripub märss, vööl lähker. All, paremas nurgas kaks puunõud. Paremal: rahvariietes istuv naisefiguur, poolpöördes vasakule. Tagaplaanil seinal ripuvad mõõk ning laiaääreline kübar.
8845.de: The work is divided into three parts. On the left: a campfire, with three figures sitting around it. In the centre a fair-haired man holding onto a gate. A knapsack hangs on his back, a flask on his belt. Below, in the right corner, two wooden vessels. On the right: a seated female figure in folk costume, in a half-turn to the left. In the background on the wall hang a sword and a wide-brimmed hat.

8846.d: Vaade Toompea lossile alt Schnelli tiigi juurest. Allääres vesi, peegelduva kaldapealsega. Ülal paremal paistab vana müüri tagant mitmekorruseline lossihoone. Koloriit hele, valgusküllane.
8846.de: View of Toompea Castle from below, by Schnelli Pond. At the bottom water, with a reflecting embankment. Above on the right, behind an old wall, a multi-storey castle building is visible. The colour scheme is light, full of light.

8856.d: Esiplaanil katuseid ja vabrikukorstnaid; taga meri.
8856.de: In the foreground roofs and factory chimneys; behind, the sea.

8865.d: Laual mitmesuguseid köögivilju - rediseid, tomateid, kapsaid, porgandeid, kurke, üks sidrun. Keskel kauss lillkapsastega. Vasakul lähker ja klaas, paremal pudel ja taldrik.
8865.de: Various vegetables on the table - radishes, tomatoes, cabbages, carrots, cucumbers, one lemon. In the middle a bowl with cauliflowers. On the left a flask and a glass, on the right a bottle and a plate.

8867.d: Esiplaanil saan kihutavate hobustega (must, roosa, kaks punast - külgvaates). Saanis pukis ja tagaistmel heledas riietuses figuurid.
8867.de: In the foreground a sledge with galloping horses (black, pink, two red - seen from the side). Figures in light-coloured clothing on the sledge's box seat and in the back seat.

8989.d: Horisontaalidele üles ehitatud maastikukompositsioon: esiplaanil rohuriba ja täiskülvamata põld, sellest kõrgemal pikkade värviliste täppivate pintslilöökidega maalitud taluhooned, puud ja põõsad. Ülal helesinine taevas. Domineerivad eredad rohelised ja sinised värvitoonid, maalitud väga pastoosselt.
8989.de: A landscape composition built up in horizontals: in the foreground a strip of grass and an unsown field, above it farm buildings, trees and bushes painted with long, colourful, dotted brushstrokes. Above a light blue sky. Bright green and blue colour tones dominate, painted very impasto.

9000.d: Poolfiguur palvetajast vanemast naisest, kelle pilk hardunult ülespoole suunatud ja käed kokku pandud. Peas must rätt ja lahtiselt allalangeva musta ülariide alt näha hallikas pruun riietus avausega lõua all.
9000.de: Half-figure of an elderly praying woman, her gaze devoutly directed upward and her hands clasped together. On her head a black scarf, and beneath the loosely falling black outer garment, a greyish-brown attire with an opening under the chin is visible.

9004.d: Esiplaanil hallides toonides jõgi, taga paremal Pirita kloostri varemed ja rohelusse uppunud kloostri surnuaed. Vasakus servas osa väikesest majast. Ülal jupike erinevates sinistes toonides antud taevast. Määrdunud hallides ja rohelistes toonides, kohati värvikiht väga pastoosne ja pintslivarrega modelleeritud.
9004.de: In the foreground a river in grey tones, behind it on the right the ruins of Pirita Convent and the convent cemetery submerged in greenery. In the left edge part of a small house. Above, a patch of sky given in various shades of blue. In dirty grey and green tones, in places the paint layer is very impasto and modelled with the brush handle.

9013.d: Esiplaanil rikkalikult kaetud laud. Ees must ja valge lastud lind, keraamiline nõu sangaga (ornamentidega kaunistatud); kõrvits, millest lõigatud viil lebab laual. Kõrvitsa taga korv viinamarjade ja viinamarjaväätidega. Korvi ees paremal kolm virsikut, tumedad ploomid ja väike viinamarjakobar üle laua ääre rippumas. Foon ühtlaselt pruunikas.
9013.de: In the foreground a richly laid table. In front a black and white shot bird, a ceramic vessel with a handle (decorated with ornaments); a pumpkin, from which a cut slice lies on the table. Behind the pumpkin a basket with grapes and grapevines. In front of the basket on the right three peaches, dark plums and a small bunch of grapes hanging over the edge of the table. Background evenly brownish.

9047.d: Suvine maastik veekoguga esiplaanil. Veekogu paremal kaldal maja inimfiguuridega. Tagaplaanil elumaja puude keskel.
9047.de: A summer landscape with a body of water in the foreground. On the right bank of the water, a house with human figures. In the background a dwelling house amid trees.

9060.d: Nõmmemaastikus heledakarvaline, tumedate laikudega koer. Parem esikäpp tõstetud, keha kolmveerandpöördes vasakule. Maalitud hoogsalt; kasutatud vineeripinda, jättes viimase tahtlikult värvivabaks.
9060.de: In a heathland landscape a light-coated dog with dark spots. Right forepaw raised, body in a three-quarter turn to the left. Painted vigorously; a plywood surface is used, the latter deliberately left free of paint.

9064.d: Noore naise profiilportree. Ülakeha ettekummardatud; parem käsi väljasirutatud, vasak kõverdatud keha alla. Pilk suunatud vaatajale. Taust rohelistes toonides.
9064.de: Profile portrait of a young woman. Upper body leaning forward; right hand extended, left bent under the body. Gaze directed at the viewer. Background in green tones.

9065.d: Lillal, kaarjal pinnal neli, kollase pastelliga joonistatud naisefiguuri. Kolm seisavad, käed kõverdatud kukla taha; üks istub, käed ümber põlvede.
9065.de: On a lilac, curved surface, four female figures drawn with yellow pastel. Three are standing, arms bent behind the neck; one is sitting, arms around her knees.

9066.d: Suvise maastiku taustal kolm meest. Keskmisel seljas kollane lühike kuub ning peas sama värvi müts. Paremalt embab teda õlgadest, vööl lühikest mõõka kandev mees. Vasakul, küljega vaataja poole seisev noormees, hoidmas keskmise mehe vasakut kätt; pea kergelt langetatud. Kõigil üle parema õla loomanahad.
9066.de: Three men against the background of a summer landscape. The middle one wears a short yellow coat and a cap of the same colour. On the right, a man embraces him by the shoulders, wearing a short sword at his belt. On the left, a young man standing sideways to the viewer, holding the middle man's left hand; his head slightly lowered. All of them have animal skins over their right shoulder.

9072.d: Keskealise mehe rindportree otsevaates. Peas alla lastud kõrvadega pruun karusnahkne müts.
9072.de: Frontal chest portrait of a middle-aged man. Brown fur hat with lowered ear flaps on his head.

9148.d: Naturalistlikult elusuuruses kahe noormehe kaardimängustseen. Paremapoolsel noorukil tumehall ülikond ja tumedad lühikesed juuksed, toetub parema käega lauale, vasaku käega, milles kaardid, aga tooli seljatoele. Vasakpoolne, mustas ülikonnas noormees, istub laua taga, vasak käsi üles tõestetud. Laual pakk mängukaarte ja metallraha. Foon ühtlaselt tume.
9148.de: A naturalistic, life-size card-game scene with two young men. The young man on the right wears a dark grey suit and has dark short hair, leaning with his right hand on the table, with his left hand, in which he holds cards, on the back of a chair. The young man on the left, in a black suit, sits at the table, left hand raised. On the table a deck of playing cards and metal coins. The background is uniformly dark.

9198.d: Vasakul aia taga, sinise taeva taustal hele kirikuhoone. Paremas servas üksik mänd.
9198.de: On the left behind a fence, against a blue sky background, a light-coloured church building. In the right edge a solitary pine.

9208.d: Esiplaanil lage plats; tagapool puude rea taga nõmmistul üksikud figuurid. Taustaks kõrged kivihooned.
9208.de: In the foreground an open square; behind, beyond a row of trees, individual figures on the heath. Background of tall stone buildings.

9261.d: Kollakaspruunil alusel, mis katab maali alumise kolmandiku, asetsevad vasakus kuldlõikes kõrvits, millest väljalõigatud lõik asetseb paremal. Ees kaks virsikut. Kõrvitsalõigu taga paremal taldrik siniste ploomidega, osaliselt varrelehtedega, selle taga paremal kooniline pokaal punase veiniga. Taldriku ees kolm punast ploomi ja ploomioksake, mille leht ulatub üle lauaääre. Tagaplaanil vasakul pildiäärel sinine ploom varre ja lehtedega.
9261.de: On a yellowish-brown base covering the lower third of the painting, in the left golden section lies a pumpkin, a cut-out piece of which is placed on the right. In front, two peaches. Behind the pumpkin piece on the right a plate with blue plums, partly with stems and leaves, behind it on the right a conical goblet with red wine. In front of the plate three red plums and a small plum branch, whose leaf extends over the edge of the table. In the background on the left edge of the picture a blue plum with stem and leaves.

9286.d: Kompositsioon ülesehitatud kaarja ülaosaga väljale. Laia, diagonaalse pinnana läbib seda vahutav veevool. Ees, kaldal kaks jooksvat figuuri - lehvivate juuste ning rõivastega naine ja tema kannul mees, vasak käsi haardevalmilt ettesirutatud; parem mõõgaga peakohale tõstetud. Kaare kohal, ülemises vasakus ja paremas nurgas kaks kolba kujutist.
9286.de: The composition is built on a field with an arched upper part. A wide, diagonal plane of foaming water flows through it. In front, on the shore, two running figures - a woman with flowing hair and garments and, following her, a man, his left hand outstretched ready to grasp; his right hand raised above his head with a sword. Above the arch, in the upper left and right corners, two depictions of flasks.

9287.d: Mereäärsel kaldapealsel poollamavas asendis mees, keha katab loomanahk; parema käsivarre ümber kuldne võru. Punastes ja kollastes toonides leekiva taeva taustal hiigelsuur kotkas, pea pööratud paremale, mehe suunas.
9287.de: On a seaside shore a man in a half-reclining position, his body covered with an animal hide; a golden band around his right forearm. Against the background of a blazing sky in red and yellow tones a huge eagle, its head turned to the right, towards the man.

9315.dm: laius: 44.6 cm (arm   ); kõrgus: 35.7 cm; kõrgus: 35.3 cm (arm  ); laius: 44.8 cm
9315.d: Looduses lõkke ümber tantsiv paar, nendest mõlemal pool istuvad grupid. Vasakul tagapool karjapasunast ja kandlemängijast grupp. Inimfiguurid kõik rahvariietes, naistel punased seelikud, mehed sinistes pükstes.
9315.de: A couple dancing around a bonfire in nature, with seated groups on both sides. Behind on the left, a group with a shepherd's horn and a kannel player. All human figures are in folk costumes, the women in red skirts, the men in blue trousers.

9316.dm: laius: 100.5 cm; kõrgus: 68.5 cm (arm   ); kõrgus: 53.0 cm; laius: 105.0 cm (arm)
9316.d: Roosaka stiliseeritud jõemaastiku taustal paat kahe alasti meesfiguuriga. Üks juhib paati, teine hoiab suurt ambu laskevalmis. Nende vahel paadis mahalastud luiged.
9316.de: Against the background of a pink stylised river landscape, a boat with two naked male figures. One is steering the boat, the other holding a large bow ready to shoot. Between them in the boat, shot-down swans.

9413.d: Neli meest, seljaga vaataja poole, kannavad õlgadel raami surnuga. Tagaplaanil, vasakul põleb suur lõke.
9413.de: Four men, their backs to the viewer, carry a frame with a dead body on their shoulders. In the background, on the left, a large bonfire is burning.

9417.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kaks hane ja tütarlaps toetumas aiale. Keskel taulpoeg naisega palgikoormal hobust jões jootmas. Maanteel, taamal paremal liikumas hobused talupoegadega. Maantee ääres kõrts peatuvate hobustega. Paremal maali serval keskel asuva üle jõe viiva silla jalal veok, mille koorma otsas istuv naine pingutab lõhkuva hobuse ohje, kuna seisev mees hobuse ees parema käega hoiab aisast kinni. Nende vastu sõidab suure kiirusega kahe hobusega veok kahe talupojaga. Sillast vasakul jõe ääres joodab talupoeg hobust. Hobusest vasakul läheb kari kodu poole.(eesti)
9417.de: In the foreground on the left two geese and a girl leaning on a fence. In the centre, a peasant boy with a woman on a load of logs watering a horse in the river. On the road, further back on the right, horses with peasants moving. By the roadside an inn with stopping horses. On the right edge of the painting, at the foot of a bridge crossing the river in the centre, a cart on which a woman sitting on the load pulls at the reins of a bolting horse, while a standing man in front of the horse holds the shaft with his right hand. Coming towards them at great speed is a cart with two horses and two peasants. To the left of the bridge, by the riverside, a peasant waters a horse. To the left of the horse, a herd is heading home.

9425.d: Mustas pihtseelikus ja valges pluusis vanema naise rindportree otsevaates.
9425.de: Bust portrait of an older woman in a black pinafore skirt and white blouse, in frontal view.

9436.d: Esiplaanil sillerdav hallikassinine veepind. Silmapiiril vasakul purjekas, kauguses veel kahe purjelaeva purjed. Helesinine, silmapiiri kohal rippuvate roosakate pilvedega taevas.(eesti)
9436.de: In the foreground a shimmering greyish-blue water surface. On the horizon to the left a sailboat, in the distance also the sails of two more sailing ships. A light blue sky with pinkish clouds hanging above the horizon.

9459.d: Tumesinise tähistaeva taustal, laineliste leekidega alasi kõrval seisab harkisjalu noormees selgvaates. Vasakus tõstetud käes hoiab viieharulist tähte, parem vasaraga löögivalmis. Mehel heledad pikad juuksed seljal, seljas kääritud käistega hele särk, puss vööl, jalas viisud. Valdavalt erksad sinised-kollased toonid, dekoratiivne kujutamislaad.
9459.de: Against the background of a dark blue starry sky, beside an anvil with wavy flames, stands a young man with legs apart, seen frontally. In his raised left hand he holds a five-pointed star, his right hand with a hammer ready to strike. The man has long light hair down his back, wears a light shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a knife at his belt, and bast shoes on his feet. Predominantly bright blue and yellow tones, decorative manner of depiction.

9512.d: Valgel ratsul kappamas alasti mehefiguur, jalad põlvede juurest äralõigatud. Parem käsi tõstetud, vasak hoidmas hobuse lakka. Heledad juuksed tuules lehvimas. Paremal kaks vasakule looka paindunud puud. Taust erksates sinistes-oranzides värvides.
9512.de: A nude male figure galloping on a white steed, legs cut off at the knees. Right hand raised, left hand holding the horse's mane. Fair hair fluttering in the wind. On the right two trees bent leftward in an arc. The background in bright blue and orange colors.

9513.d: Grisais maalitud habemega vanema mehe portree, profiilis paremale. Käed ristatud lõua alla, ees ümarate raamidega prillid.
9513.de: Portrait of a bearded older man painted in grisaille, in profile to the right. Arms crossed below the chin, in front round-framed glasses.

9514.dm: kujutise kõrgus: 18.9 cm (km); lehe laius: 23.5 cm (lm ); kujutise laius: 21.3 cm (km  ); lehe kõrgus: 18.9 cm (lm  )
9514.d: Esiplaanil peegelsile jõepind. Kaldad kaetud metsaga. Keskel, kalda all üksik paat.
9514.de: In the foreground a mirror-smooth river surface. The banks covered with forest. In the middle, below the bank, a lone boat.

9644.d: Vanema, täishabet kandva mehe portree. Pilk suunatud otse vaatjale. Ninajuurel ja suu ümber sügavad kurrud. Kaelusest paistab punane rätt. Taust helesinine.
9644.de: Portrait of an elderly man with a full beard. Gaze directed straight at the viewer. Deep wrinkles at the bridge of the nose and around the mouth. A red scarf shows from the collar. Background light blue.

9785.dm: kõrgus: 64.0 cm; laius: 46.0 cm; kõrgus: 84.0 cm (raamiga); laius: 68.0 cm (raamiga)
9785.d: 10 aastase (omaniku andmetel) tütarlapse portree poolprofiilis paremale, seljas hallikas valge kraega kleit, peas punane pael. Taustaks kuppelmaastik, sinises taevas roosakad pilved.
9785.de: Portrait of a girl, 10 years old (according to the owner's information), in half-profile to the right, wearing a grayish-white dress with a collar, a red ribbon on her head. Background a domed landscape, pinkish clouds in a blue sky.

9817.d: Vanemas eas mehe rindportree mustjal taustal, kannab hele- ja tumesinist riietust, lahtise kaelsusega. Kujutatu pea on pööratud kergelt paremale, juukseid on vähe, ent tume habe katab suurema osa näo alumsisest osast. Ilme on sünge, tõsist pilku kroonivad heledad kulmud.
9817.de: A bust portrait of an elderly man against a blackish background, wearing light and dark blue clothing with an open collar. The sitter's head is turned slightly to the right, his hair is thin, but a dark beard covers most of the lower part of his face. His expression is sombre, his serious gaze crowned by light eyebrows.

9875.d: Hämaras ruumis klaveri taga musitseeriv noor mees külgvaates, käed klahvidel, pea pööratud vaatajale. Mehel ümar laup, pisut punnis silmad. Tumeda pintsaku alt hele kaelus paistmas. Tausta interjöör maalitud laiade mehaaniliste täppivate tõmmetega imiteerides klaveril asetseva oranži lambi värelevat kuma. Valdavalt tumedad sinkjaslillad, rohekad mürgised toonid.
9875.de: In a dim room, a young man making music at a piano, seen in side view, hands on the keys, head turned towards the viewer. The man has a rounded forehead, slightly bulging eyes. A light-coloured collar shows beneath the dark jacket. The interior background is painted with broad, mechanical, precise strokes imitating the flickering glow of an orange lamp standing on the piano. Predominantly dark bluish-purple, greenish poisonous tones.

9876.d: Heledapäise noore naise poolfiguur tugitoolis istumas veerandpöördes paremale, käed süles. Naise pea pisut rinnal, pilk vaatajale suunatud. Seljas hele kleit, lopsakas hele sall õlgadel. Taustal tubane interjöör klaveriga, nipsasju sellel. Värvikas maalilaad, domineerivad erksad rohekad, sinkjaslillad toonid.
9876.de: Half-figure of a fair-haired young woman sitting in an armchair, turned a quarter to the right, hands in her lap.
